product.title: Historic Downtown, Miraflores & Catacombs Private Tour

description.text: In Lima, this private half-day circuit covers Miraflores, a San Isidro pass, and Centro Historico de Lima with a dedicated guide and vehicle for one group. The published route walks the Malecon, Love Park, and Kennedy Park before the historic-center squares, then offers a guided visit to the San Francisco Convent and catacombs or Huaca Pucllana. Snacks, a drink, and the San Francisco admission ticket are listed on the product page. Morning, afternoon, or early evening departures are offered from the confirmed Lima accommodations. The format suits visitors who want a guided city window without assembling taxi, ticket, and neighborhood timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on Miraflores, San Isidro, and Centro Historico de Lima that define this private outing rather than a Barranco night add-on.
